name: claude-obsidian
tagline_zh: 丢进任何资料，Claude 自动读、连、归档成一张知识网。不用手动建链接，你的 Obsidian 笔记自己长成第二。
tagline_en: Drop anything in; Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected graph. Your Obsidian grows into a second.
desc_en: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph o
why_zh: 同类工具只做检索，它主动建立概念关联，让笔记从文件夹变成活的网络，越用越懂你。
why_en: Unlike search-only tools, it actively builds conceptual links, turning your vault into a living network that learns your thinking.
